expected_facts: Raw integer counts are analyzed with PyDESeq2 using a young-versus-old contrast
The complete DE table contains log2FoldChange, pvalue, and padj
All tested genes are ranked for GSEA Prerank rather than thresholded before enrichment
GSEA significance is reported using FDR q-value below 0.25
guidelines: Use HGNC symbols for the supplied symbol-based GMT library
Do not substitute a t-test for count-based differential expression

expected_facts: Non-count annotation columns are excluded before PyDESeq2 fitting
Sex is included before condition in the design
Ensembl identifiers are mapped to HGNC symbols before enrichment
GSEA Prerank uses the complete DE ranking with a fixed seed and 1000 permutations
guidelines: Do not pass annotation strings into DeseqDataSet
Do not interpret near-zero library overlap as absent biology

expected_facts: The count matrix is recognized as samples by genes and is not transposed
The metadata column age group is renamed to age_group for the formula
Original young and old values are retained in the contrast
GSEA Prerank is run on a symbol-indexed complete ranking
guidelines: Do not produce a dot plot unless requested

expected_facts: Counts and metadata are aligned on their shared sample identifiers
The unmatched metadata-only sample is reported and excluded
Low-count genes are filtered before fitting
GSEA Prerank is preferred over ORA because a full ranked DE table is available
guidelines: Do not silently fabricate counts for the unmatched sample
Do not pool up- and down-regulated genes into one ORA list
